description.value: Cosports is a large indoor racket sports facility in Port Coquitlam featuring 17 professional badminton courts with Tinsue rubber flooring, plus table tennis, light volleyball, and newly opened pickleball courts. Courts can be rented by the day, week, or year, and the facility hosts competitive tournaments such as the Thanksgiving Cup table tennis event. Racket stringing services are also available on site.
